entries.summary: Dell guidance strengthens conditional AI recovery case, but overnight futures remain negative and inflation risk dominates.
bullish: Dell raised annual revenue guidance to $202B from $192B; shares rose about 5% after hours.
Dow and Russell rose despite Nasdaq losses; paired yields show 10Y easing.
bearish: Semiconductor shares fell 7.9% per Reuters; NVDA, MU and AMD led losses.
Overnight NQ underperforms ES; December tightening expectations remain strong.

editorial.marketOverview: Tuesday closed with Nasdaq down 1.48% while Dow and small caps gained. Chip losses were pronounced, and overnight NQ remained negative at the last available delayed observation. This is consistent with a fragile technology reversal rather than uniform liquidation.
editorial.whatChanged: Compared with the persisted Tuesday afternoon report, Dell delivered stronger AI infrastructure results and lifted guidance. The reported after-hours gain is a new positive catalyst, but the broader overnight futures response does not confirm a recovery. Open Watch count remains unchanged.
editorial.marketInterpretation: Strong server demand supports the AI investment thesis, but memory cost pressures and elevated policy expectations constrain valuations. The paired Treasury report shows a positive 23.3 bp curve; lower long yields alone have not restored chip leadership. Breadth is modestly negative according to Reuters.
editorial.threeDayPath: Wednesday is dominated by inflation and GDP, with Dell guidance offering a conditional rebound opportunity. Friday's shortened session may amplify price swings. Monday offers a better test of whether semiconductor leadership and normal liquidity return.
editorial.bullCase: Benign PCE and falling yields combined with broad chip participation could allow Monday's earlier rebound to resume. Dell's stronger outlook provides a fundamental basis, but confirmation requires market-wide participation.
editorial.bearCase: Hot inflation or renewed chip selling despite Dell's results would suggest the rebound is failing. Higher oil and tightening expectations may reinforce pressure on long-duration technology.
editorial.watchNext: Check PCE and GDP at 08:30 ET, then SOX versus QQQ, Nasdaq breadth, VXN/VIX and paired yields. Monitor the Beige Book and Friday liquidity. Do not interpret delayed futures as live quotes.
